source._comment: Official: Iowa SoS 'Daily Absentee Statistics - By County' PDF linked from stats_page (site moved in 2026; the June primary file is sites/default/files/2026-06/ABS Counties 2026.pdf; the general file isn't posted as of 2026-10-09). Hierarchical: county line (Requested Issued Received), then party lines (Democrat/Republican/No Party/Libertarian/Other), then receipt-method lines; party RECEIVED = ballots cast. Until it posts: UF Election Lab stand-in (IA_county.csv + IA_cd/IA_sdl/IA_sdu, source Iowa SoS), CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. validation_url = persisted 2024 file.
